about: Art made by people with permission, shown as paper cut-outs or models. See docs/ART_PACK.md. Slots with no file show a neutral grey stand-in with a plate (LICENSED ART PENDING and the slot's name). The models of juan_salvo and cascarudo are licensed art, all rights reserved by their authors and in this repository with their permission for use with Hora Cero only (NOTICE); emptying their file, lod and portrait brings the stand-ins back. Check with: python3 tools/art_pack.py check

credit.author: Santiago Siri
credit.licence: permiso para usar en Hora Cero
credit.source: a Meshy AI biped on a Mixamo skeleton (10,390 triangles, 2K textures, nine clips) put into Godot by a friend of Ale's; made ready with tools/juan_suit.py (metres and Y up, a standing rest with the rifle in his hands, Idle/Walk/Run/Jump), which gives him the blue-hood Juan's rifle (art/juan_salvo/source/rifle.glb); his portrait is the avatar that came with it
